scope: unfitted transfer of frozen cell candidate to six previously exposed DEVELOPMENT module files only; no reserved files
topology: 6s2p; predict mean-cell voltage=AVL_Voltage/6, per-cell current=-AVL_Current/2, positive discharge
current_sign_check: verify net charge counter AhAccu_Charge+AhAccu_Discharge against cumulative positive AVL current; reject opposite net direction in informative windows
timing: all required measurement tables must share length and index; RecordingTime strictly increasing and finite; first prediction window maxdt<=2s
window: first abs(module current)>10A sample, require at least5 preceding samples with abs(current)<=1A; first300s after activation or available shorter duration if at least60s; no residual based selection
initial_condition: mean last5 quiet module voltages/6 and mean available cell-surface temperatures A1,A2,A3,B1,C1,D1,E1,E2,E3 over same5 rows; infer initialSOC by fixed OCV inversion in[0.05,0.95], no later samples used; reject unbracketed initialOCV
model: frozen kinetic+OCP candidate; all parameters fixed; isothermal initial measured surface temperature; measured current interpolated at recorded times; no module parameter fit
solvers: SPMe and DFN mesh40 rtol1e-7 atol1e-8, each90s limit; no silent truncation
limitations: first300s sentinel, not whole charging cycle or two-hour thermal test; initial equilibrium/homogeneity assumed from protocol; same recovered module, no independent-unit population inference; exploratory out-of-cell transfer; reference cell and module may differ in age/capacity
thermal: report measured temperature drift but do not claim temperature prediction
